regions.text: 以Eを蓋然性と考へるからである。從つて既に云つたやうに12以下は非蓋然性と云ふことが出來る。

quote.translation: When Kant, regarding what makes something probable, says that the ratio of the insufficient Grounds to the sufficient Grounds is greater than the ratio of the Grounds of the opposite to the sufficient Grounds, and again that probability is greater than half of certainty, this is because he thinks of 1/2 and above as probability, and consequently, as we have already said, what lies below 1/2 can be called improbability.

regions.text: 斯やうな05以上の蓋然性が狭義の蓋然性であるが、確率論の取扱ふ蓋然性は1と0との間の全體に委當する度義の蓋然性である。

quote.translation: Probability of 0.5 and above, of this kind, is probability in the narrow sense, but the probability with which probability theory deals is probability in the broad sense, valid for the whole range between 1 and 0.

regions.text: なほ蓋然性が必然性と不可能性との中間に位置を占める以上は可能性と偶然性とに對する關係が考察されなければならない。

quote.translation: And since probability occupies a position midway between necessity and impossibility, its relation to possibility and contingency must also be considered.

regions.text: 可能性と偶然性とは度義の蓋然性の任意の度合のところに、謂はば背中合せに立つてゐるものである。可能性は1の方を向き偶然性は0の方を向いてゐる。以上の開係を上の図形で表はさう。

quote.translation: Possibility and contingency stand, so to speak, back to back at any degree whatever of probability in the broad sense, possibility facing towards 1 and contingency facing towards 0.
